needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk on the left; the red van and other vehicles are parked at the road edge with no usable footway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous 1.5 m paved footway on the left, set back from the parked red van, to give pedestrians a safe place to walk.

needed.evidence: Market stalls, umbrellas and goods occupy the right-side path, blocking it.
needed.suggestion: Relocate the market stalls to a designated off-road market area and clear the right-side path so it is fully usable.

needed.evidence: The right-side path is uneven and cluttered with goods and stall bases, creating trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right-side footway and remove stall bases to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: High pedestrian activity and market access create crossing demand, but no marked or purpose-built crossing is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with high-visibility markings at the market access point to give pedestrians a defined crossing.
